headline: Kenneth Blume Steps Out of Kenny Beats’s Shadow
context: The hitmaker formerly known as Kenny Beats was behind breakthrough albums for Geese, Vince Staples, Idles and Fcukers. On a new solo project, he turns his focus inward.
